stage_designation.quote: The stage presented in this report has been designated stage 52-52, with the rotor being rotor 52 and the stator being stator 52.

design_pressure_ratio_text.quote: The stage was designed for an overall pressure ratio of 1.25 and an efficiency of 0.894 at a weight flow of 32.7 kilograms per second (194.4 kg/sec/m2 of annulus area).

design_weight_flow_text.quote: at a weight flow of 32.7 kilograms per second (194.4 kg/sec/m2 of annulus area)

design_tip_speed_text.quote: The design tip speed was 257.7 meters per second.

rotor_pressure_distribution.value: quadratic, from about 1.30 at the tip to 1.17 at the hub
rotor_pressure_distribution.quote: This rotor was designed for a quadratic distribution in total pressure ratio which varied radially from about 1.30 at the tip to 1.17 at the hub.

rotor_tip_solidity.quote: The rotor was designed for a tip solidity of 0.97 and the stator had a tip solidity of 1.14.

stator_tip_solidity.quote: The rotor was designed for a tip solidity of 0.97 and the stator had a tip solidity of 1.14.

rotor_blade_count.quote: This resulted in 30 rotor blades with an aspect ratio of 2. 86 and 34 stator blades with an aspect ratio of 2. 75.

rotor_aspect_ratio.quote: 30 rotor blades with an aspect ratio of 2. 86

stator_blade_count.quote: 34 stator blades with an aspect ratio of 2. 75.

stator_aspect_ratio.quote: 34 stator blades with an aspect ratio of 2. 75.

rotor_profile.quote: Both the rotor and stator used double-circular-arc blade profiles.

stator_profile.quote: Both the rotor and stator used double-circular-arc blade profiles.

stator_axial_spacings_tested.unit: rotor tip chords downstream of the rotor trailing edge
stator_axial_spacings_tested.quote: In order to evaluate the effect of spacing between the rotor and stator, the stage was tested with the stators spaced 1, 2, and 4 rotor tip chords downstream of the rotor trailing edge.

stator_spacing_in_fig1.quote: The overall design parameters for stage 52-52 are listed in table I, and the flow path is shown in figure 1. The stators are located 4 rotor chords downstream of the rotor in the figure.

stator_spacing_of_tabulated_data.quote: All the plotted data together with some additional performance parameters for the stage configuration with the stators at the 2 chord position are presented in tabular form.

instrumentation_same_for_all_spacings.quote: It should be noted that the instrumentation locations were the same for all three stator spacing tests.

rotor_tip_clearance_cold.quote: The nonrotating radial tip clearance of the rotor was a nominal 0.05 centimeter at ambient conditions.

blade_mounting.value: rotor blades pin mounted in the hub; stator blades mounted in the outer casing, supported by a small retaining ring at the hub
blade_mounting.quote: The rotor blades were pin mounted in the hub. ... The stator blades were mounted in the outer casing and supported by a small retaining ring at the hub.

part_span_damper.quote: (no damper is mentioned in the text)

survey_stations.value: 1 upstream of rotor, 2 between rotor and stator, 3 downstream of stator; 9 radial positions; axial positions shown only graphically in Fig. 1 (no numbers)
survey_stations.quote: Radial surveys of the flow were made upstream of the rotor, between the rotor and the stator, and downstream of the stator (fig. 1).

stator_passage_traverse.quote: The combination probes downstream of the stator (station 3) were circumferentially traversed one stator blade passage (10.6°) counterclockwise from the nominal values shown.

data_translated_to_blade_edges.quote: The data, measured at the three measuring stations, have been translated to the blade leading and trailing edges by the method presented in reference 4.

z_reference.quote: axial distance referenced from rotor blade hub leading edge, cm (appendix A); Fig. 1 axis: 'Axial distance (referenced from rotor blade hub leading edge), Z, cm'

zic_definition_appendixC.quote: ZIC axial distance to blade leading edge from inlet, cm

percent_span_definition.value: percent of blade span from tip at rotor outlet
percent_span_definition.quote: PERCENT SPAN percent of blade span from tip at rotor outlet

angle_convention_beta.quote: air angle, angle between air velocity and axial direction, deg
